At today's "Surprise and Shine" event, Apple has updated its official Design Resources website with new product bezel materials for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Details below.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro bezel materials now available

Designers should be familiar with the Apple Design Resources website, which provides a range of hardware and software assets for use in their own work.

These include Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG and SVG assets for Apple platforms, products and technologies, as well as fonts, SF Symbols, Apple's Icon Composer, and badges and logos for services such as Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

Following today's announcement of the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, Apple has updated the Design Resources website with Photoshop and PNG assets for these two new devices.

These assets include the iPhone Duo shown in both unfolded and folded states and in two colour options, as well as the iPhone 18 Pro model featuring a smaller Dynamic Island.

To view the newly added bezel materials and other assets available on the Apple Design Resources website, click this link.
